decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed side infill illustrated in drawings 0801/P0007 - 0801/P010, received on 26 February 2009, for 5 Hearne Road, would by virtue of its prominence, bulk, height and disproportionate scale be harmful to the living conditions of adjoining neighbours. The proposal would lead to an unreasonable sense of enclosure and be unduly dominant and oppressive with shadowing to a kitchen window. It would therefore be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and Supplementary Planning Guidance for Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed side infill would by virtue of its prominence, bulk, height and disproportionate scale be harmful to the original character and proportions of the dwelling and would fail to preserve the character of the Conservation Area. It would therefore be contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The proposed side infill extension, by virtue of its size and having due regard for the characteristics of the dwelling and property at 5 Hearne Road, Chiswick would result in undue harm to the character of the property, by overdeveloping the dwelling and providing an unsatisfactory amount of outdoor amenity space. The proposal would therefore be inconsistent with UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and supplementary planning guidance.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
